# Source review and coverage

<!-- Generated by scripts/render_registry.py; evidence lives in reviews/. -->

Reviewed 2026-10-06. **14 default global skills, 218 installable project selections, 67 profiles, 190 manual integrations, and 4,186 indexed source entries across 28 sources.**

The catalog represents the 27 skill-source repositories and the official successor to OpenAI's deprecated skills repository reviewed during setup. Additional runtime and article reviews are linked below without implying catalog registration. Deep review covers selected bodies, applicable companions and integration boundaries. The inventory also contains mirrors, discovery stubs and candidates whose internals have not been fully read. It is not a claim that every line of every source has been audited.

- **Installable:** reviewed selection with exact source and adapted hashes, retained notices, and recorded dependencies. This is not runtime certification.
- **Manual:** valuable skill/package with specific runtime, correctness, companion or licensing work remaining.
- **Indexed-only:** source discovery metadata needing review before selection. Advertisement-only wrappers remain labeled.

No upstream installers, paid APIs or runtime programs were executed during source review. Original authored workflows provide portable alternatives where copying an upstream package would be unsuitable.

## Material boundaries

Agent-browser is a native browser runtime, not just a skill file; its install and authentication paths need explicit setup. Planning-with-files has lifecycle hooks in skill frontmatter. The authored work-planning skill supplies portable durable state without those hooks. GEO workflows contain unsupported scores and factual assumptions; search-visibility supplies evidence-based alternatives. Addy selections retain repository-level companions through explicit file maps and bounded literal corrections.

Remotion lacks an explicit verified license at the pinned revision and remains manual. Vercel agent-skills declares MIT in README/frontmatter but supplies no standalone license file; that evidence and caveat are retained. Context-mode uses Elastic-2.0. Anthropic office implementations have restrictive local terms. Awesome Skills has per-source exceptions. OpenDesign includes advertisement-only wrappers. These boundaries are not erased by marketplace export.

## Verification and maintenance

See [verification evidence](verification.md) for source-byte checks, isolated registration and platform limits. Update source pins, reviewed payload hashes, integration notes and inventory together. Use `python3 ai.py catalog hash <id> --source-tree /reviewed/checkout` to calculate hashes; this does not approve new bytes. Regenerate discovery docs with `python3 scripts/render_registry.py`.

Project synchronization requires the complete [receipt contract](project-targets.md#provenance-and-executable-integrity), including source and installed hashes, explicit commit provenance and the executable-file list. Missing fields are not inferred from the current catalog.

Global links follow the checkout; managed copies and project installations change through synchronization. Local edits are preserved. Shared instructions require appropriate skill pickup but cannot guarantee model behavior or enforce a security boundary.
